policy: No third-party data file is committed to this repository. Files are staged in a user-local directory (default chui_data/, git-ignored) and bound to a run by SHA-256 in the .param.txt configuration.

datasets.energy_convention_review: Gnat & Ferland 2012 sect. 2 (arXiv:1111.6980v1, fetched sha256 cce27ad0...): the efficiencies remove electron kinetic energy via collisional ionization (included) and count only the kinetic energy of recombining electrons (recombination potential release excluded). This matches CHUI's collisional_ionization_work_in_cooling convention: the thermal equation uses n_e * sum_k n_k * L_k and the stored ion potential is a separate diagnostic partition (metal_ion_potential_delta_erg), never subtracted again. Ladder elements are removed from the element-table (C01) query, so C01 and C02 never both cool the same element.
limitations: 1e4-1e8 K only: below 1e4 K the ladder is refused (metal_cooling_table_range = reject) or clamped and counted
low-density, optically thin, collisional: no metal photoionization/photoheating (FG20 TREECOOL cannot supply them)
with chemistry_adaptive_selection, demoted rows need an element table for the ladder elements (enforced)
